onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

tone_on_time.Description: Onset time of the cue tone (Tone A/B/C).

tone_off_time.Description: Offset time of the cue tone (Tone A/B/C).

action_on_time.Description: Onset time of poking L or R.

action_off_time.Description: Offset time of poking L or R.

pokeC_on_time.Description: Onset time of poking the center hole.

pokeC_off_time.Description: Offset time of poking the center hole (≈ action selection onset).

reward_on_time.Description: Onset time at pellet dish infrared sensor (pellet presence).

reward_off_time.Description: Offset time when rat picked up the pellet.

FirstTrial.Description: ID of the first trial in block

LastTrial.Description: ID of the last trial in block

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.BlockDesign: The 'BlockDesign' table in the NWB file.

BlockDesign.Description: id: running block index; start/stop: from first/last trial; FinishedBlock(1/0), FirstTrial, LastTrial, RewardRule_L/R.
